spec.assertion: Trigger must be stageEnter{stage:1} (any ally's stage-1 cast), NOT burstCast (she is Burst II — her own cast is stage 2, so a burstCast encoding would fire at the wrong frame and, in a comp where she is not the stage-1 caster, at the wrong cadence). Proven by asserting hitRatePct applies exist and do not coincide with her own burstCast frames.

Value must be NEGATIVE 20 with maxStacks 3, self-scoped, no durationSec. Fails under the nearest-wrong ▼-read-as-▲ (positive 20 lifts her core rate instead of dropping it), under an allies target (would debuff the team), and under a durationSec encoding (“continuously” = permanent until Hangover removes it).

spec.kitLine: only when in Drunken → all allies
spec.assertion: The ally branch must be GATED on ≥1 Drunken stack, so nothing lands before the first stage-1 burst. Fails under a plain {kind:'passive'} encoding: the counterfactual patch makes the branch ungated and ally damage rises strictly, proving the gate is modeled and load-bearing.

Flat 20.05 on every apply, to all allies, generic critRatePct (the text does NOT scope it to normal attacks). Fails under a per-stack encoding (would emit 40.10/60.15) and under critRateNormalPct (which would under-credit skill/burst crit).

Must be casterAtkPct, flat-resolved on buffApply to 0.3502 × her staticAtk. Fails under atkPct (target-scaled — an Attacker teammate would gain far more than the Supporter caster's share) and under asserting the raw 35.02 percentage. Also flat, not per-stack (no “x stacks” clause on this line).

Trigger = stageEnter{stage:3} + Drunken gate. Fails under burstCast (her own stage-2 cast): stage-3 entry is strictly later in the measured B2→30f→B3 chain, so no apply may share a frame with her burstCast.

distributedDamagePct, allies, value = 15.03 × live stacks (1..3), durationSec 10. Fails under a flattened 1-stack magnitude (asserted: at least one apply exceeds 1.5× the per-stack unit) and under a permanent encoding (expiresFrame must be set).
reloadSpeedPct, allies, per-stack, 10s. Guards the “reload is defensive, skip it” failure mode: zeroing it must move total team damage, because reload speed gates shots fired.

spec.kitLine: Hangover: Stunned 10 sec at FB end
spec.assertion: fullBurstEnd trigger, gated on stacks == max (3), effects = self stun 10s + full stack removal. Two discriminators: (a) removing the stun must RAISE her own damage (it is a pure uptime sink), and (b) her shot log must contain a >400-frame gap, far longer than her 171-frame reload. Stack consumption proven by a return to <3 stacks after the first max-stack application.

burstCast, allies, literal 40.04, ungated. Fails under applying the Drunken gate to the whole burst block (the kit scopes “if in Drunken status” to the SECOND branch only) — asserted by requiring at least one grant per burst cast.
attackDamagePct (Damage Up bucket), allies, literal 15.04, ungated. Fails under trueDamagePct/sustainedDamagePct mis-bucketing and under a self-only target.

Second burst branch: Drunken-gated casterAtkPct, allies, value = 0.2006 × stacks × her staticAtk, 10s. Distinguished from the skill1 35.02% grant by magnitude ratio; at least one apply must exceed 1.5× the single-stack value, killing the flat-20.06 nearest-wrong. Inertness: an ATK grant must not change her shot count.
⚑ it.skip. The kit states the Hit Rate delta but not its core-hit consequence; hrCoreMult magnitude is measured-only per the ALWAYS-⚑ list (item 7). Sign is asserted; magnitude is not.

⚑ it.skip. The kit does not state whether the max-stack removal at Full Burst end resolves before or after that rotation's stage-1 entry, so the steady-state stack trajectory (and the time-average of every per-stack line) is not derivable from prose. Measurement-gated.

fixtures: controlComp('mast-romantic-maid', true) only — one deterministic base run plus six withPatchedOverride counterfactual runs (7 runComp calls total, well under the ~20-run budget). She is Burst II, so the control comp's B1 + fixed-B3 slots are REQUIRED: they supply the full B1→B2→B3 chain, which (a) lets her burst cast at all, (b) fires the stage-1 entries that accrue Drunken stacks, (c) fires the stage-3 entries her skill2 keys to, and (d) produces the Full Burst ends that trigger Hangover. A lone-unit or fixedB3=false fixture would make every stage-gated assertion vacuous. The fixed B3 is kept ON because none of her assertions read a stat the helm slot also grants at the same magnitudes (crit rate 20.05 / crit damage 40.04 / attack damage 15.04 are all filtered by casterIdx === her slot, so a same-stat teammate grant cannot contaminate the reads).
gaps: ⚑ Hit Rate ▼20% → per-stack core-rate magnitude (hrCoreMult) — measured-only, outside a blind read's input domain; only the SIGN is asserted.

⚑ Drunken stack rebuild trajectory after Hangover — the kit does not state the ordering of max-stack removal vs the same rotation's stage-1 gain, so the steady-state stack count driving every per-stack line is not derivable from prose.

NOT a gap but flagged: whether the Hangover stun blocks her BURST cast is kit-silent. The engine's stun primitive documents 'bursting unaffected', which I adopted; if the real unit also loses her burst window the ally uptime model changes materially. Reported, not asserted.
